- The bottom-left reference panel shows a similar advanced-stage presentation with dense pustules and surrounding necrosis, closely matching the test image
- Southern rust pustules are smaller and more circular than Common rust (which tends to be more elongated/oval and darker cinnamon-brown)

The dense, small, orange-circular pustule pattern on the upper leaf surface with surrounding necrosis is a textbook presentation of Southern rust (*Puccinia polysora*).
